settings.save_failed: Toast shown when a setting could not be saved. The switch or value went back to what it was before.

language.label: Setting label on Settings, Language section. Names the app language picker.
language.description: Setting description under the Language label. 'Follow system' is the name of an option in the list (see settings.language.system). Keep that wording consistent.
language.system: Option title in the Language list. Picks the app language from the OS language. Shown with a globe icon.
language.system_current: Small subtitle under the Follow system option. {language} = language name of the OS, e.g. "Deutsch".
language.completion_hint: Hint text at the bottom of the language list card. Explains the translation progress bar next to each language. Untranslated text falls back to English.
language.translated: Label under a progress bar in the language list. {percent} = share of the app translated, e.g. 87. Keep short, about 15 characters.
language.coming_soon: Badge on a language in the Language list that is not available yet. Keep short, about 11 characters.

categories.appearance: Settings sidebar category and section heading for theme and look options.
categories.language: Settings sidebar category and section heading for the app language.
categories.startup: Settings sidebar category and section heading for launch on login, tray and background work.
categories.notifications: Settings sidebar category and section heading for which notifications you get and how they show.
categories.overlay: Settings sidebar category and section heading for the overlay drawn over the game window.
categories.privacy: Settings sidebar category and section heading for data sharing options.
categories.about: Settings sidebar category and section heading for version, updates, credits and licenses.
categories.diagnostics: Settings sidebar category and section heading for troubleshooting tools and logs.
categories.sharing: Settings sidebar category and section heading for sharing your matches with the Deadlock+ service.
categories.storage: Settings sidebar category and section heading for disk space used and cache clearing.

items.theme: Setting label on Settings, Appearance. Names the theme picker (colour schemes).
items.theme_effects: Setting label on Settings, Appearance. Names the toggles for animated art some themes draw behind the page.
items.reduced_motion: Setting label on Settings, Appearance. Names the option that turns animations and transitions off.
items.accessible_font: Setting label on Settings, Appearance. Names the switch for a more readable font.
items.close_to_tray: Setting label on Settings, Startup. Names the switch that keeps the app running in the system tray when the window closes.
items.background_jobs: Setting label on Settings, Startup. Names the group of tasks that run in the background, like scans and updates.
items.update_alerts: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the switch for alerts about new Deadlock patch notes and Steam news.
items.maintenance: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the switch for a reminder before Steam's weekly maintenance.
items.discord_presence: Page heading of the Discord presence page, also the screen reader label of its Off/Basic/Detailed option group. Discord is a product name.
items.discord_clients: Section heading on the Discord presence page above the list of installed Discord apps. Discord is a product name.
items.discord_editor: Section heading on the Discord presence page above the editor for the activity text shown on Discord.
items.match_ingest: Setting label on Settings, Match sharing. Names the switch for sending your finished matches to the Deadlock+ service.
items.telemetry: Setting label on Settings, Privacy. Names the switch for sending anonymous usage data and crash reports.
items.gc_recovery: Setting label on Settings, Match sharing. Names the switch for looking up match details the app missed while you played.
items.version: Setting row label on Settings, About. Names the row that shows the app version number.
items.whats_new: Setting row label on Settings, About. Names the row that opens the changelog.
items.updates: Setting row label on Settings, About. Names the row for checking and installing app updates.
items.thanks: Setting row label on Settings, About. Names the credits row for contributors, translators and supporters.
items.diagnostics: Setting row label on Settings, Diagnostics. Names the troubleshooting tools row.
items.licenses: Setting row label on Settings, About. Names the row listing open source licenses of libraries the app uses.
items.storage: Setting row label on Settings, Storage. Names the row showing how much disk space the app uses.
items.overlay: Setting label on Settings, Game overlay. Names the master switch for the overlay drawn over the game.
items.overlay_position: Setting label on Settings, Game overlay. Names the picker for where notifications appear on screen.
items.overlay_duration: Setting label on Settings, Game overlay. Names the slider for how long each notification stays.
items.overlay_test: Setting label on Settings, Game overlay. Names the row with a button that shows a sample notification.
items.overlay_notifications: Setting label on Settings, Game overlay. Names the row that links to the Notifications settings.
items.overlay_match_found: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the notification that fires when your queue finds a match.
items.overlay_queue_stopped: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the notification that fires when your queue stops without a match.
items.server_blocks_updated: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the notification for when server blocks were refreshed. Server Picker is a feature name.
items.server_blocks_stale: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the notification for when server blocks could not be refreshed and are old.
items.break_reminder: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the notification that suggests a break after losses.
items.front_page_after_match: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the switch for the newspaper style recap page shown after a match.
items.front_page_overlay_alert: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the notification that says a recap front page is waiting.
items.ui_scale: Setting label on Settings, Appearance. Names the slider for the size of the whole app interface.
items.hardware_acceleration: Setting label on Settings, Appearance. Names the switch for drawing the app with the graphics card.
items.open_on_game_start: Setting label on Settings, Startup. Names the switch for opening the app window when the game starts. Deadlock stays untranslated.
items.admin_access: Setting label on Settings, Startup. Names the choice for running the app with Windows administrator rights.
items.dispatch_alerts: Setting label on Settings, Notifications. Names the switch for alerts about new Dispatch editions. Dispatch is a newspaper style recap feature. Keep short, about 20 characters.

nav.label: Screen reader label for the settings sidebar navigation. Not visible.
nav.search: Placeholder text in the settings search input, also its screen reader label.
nav.back: Screen reader label for the back button at the bottom of the settings sidebar. Not visible text.
nav.no_matches: Empty state message on the settings page when search finds nothing. {query} = text the user typed, e.g. "overlay".

appearance.theme_description: Setting description under the Theme label on Settings, Appearance.
appearance.effects_description: Setting description under Theme effects. Flint Snow is a theme name, the example is its snowfall effect.
appearance.motion_description: Setting description under Reduced motion. 'Follow system' is an option name (see settings.appearance.motion_system). Keep wording consistent.
appearance.motion_system: Option in the Reduced motion selector. Uses the OS accessibility setting. Keep short, about 14 characters.
appearance.motion_reduce: Option in the Reduced motion selector. Turns animations off. Keep short, about 6 characters.
appearance.motion_full: Option in the Reduced motion selector. Keeps all animations on. Keep short, about 11 characters.
appearance.font_description: Setting description under Accessible font. Atkinson Hyperlegible is a font name, keep untranslated.
appearance.scale_description: Setting description under UI scale. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.
appearance.hardware_acceleration_description: Setting description under Hardware acceleration. Deadlock+ stays untranslated. Tells when to turn it off.
appearance.restart_app: Button on Settings, Appearance that restarts the app to apply a change. Deadlock+ stays untranslated. Keep short, about 18 characters.
appearance.accent: Heading of the accent colour editor in the theme card. Names the custom highlight colour.
appearance.accent_hue: Slider label in the accent colour editor. The colour position on the colour wheel. Keep short, about 5 characters.
appearance.accent_vividness: Slider label in the accent colour editor. How strong or saturated the colour is. Keep short, about 10 characters.
appearance.accent_hex: Label of the text input where you type a colour code like #FF8800. Keep short, about 10 characters.
appearance.accent_reset: Button in the accent colour editor that restores the theme's default accent. Keep short, about 6 characters.
appearance.theme_option_aria: Screen reader label for a control on a theme card in Settings, Appearance. {option} = what the control picks, e.g. Light or Dark. {theme} = theme name, e.g. Statlocker.

deadlock.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Deadlock stays untranslated.
deadlock.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: dark brownish black with brass coloured trim.
deadlock.source: Link text under the theme that points to the Deadlock page on Steam. Deadlock and Steam stay untranslated.

midnight.label: Theme name in the theme picker. A dark blue theme.
midnight.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: cool blue black with a soft silver accent.

effects.fog: Toggle label for the fog effect of the Midnight theme. Keep short, about 5 characters.
effects.windows: Toggle label for the lit building windows effect of the Midnight theme. Keep short, about 8 characters.

daylight.label: Theme name in the theme picker. A light theme.
daylight.description: Theme description in the theme picker. A light theme with warm paper like colours.

contrast.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Accessibility theme with maximum contrast.
contrast.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Pure black and white with strong borders.

nightshift.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Named after the Deadlock Night Shift show. Brand name, keep untranslated.
nightshift.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: dark teal with gold art deco trim.
nightshift.source: Link text under the theme that points to the Deadlock Night Shift show on Twitch. Deadlock and Twitch stay untranslated.

effects.rain: Toggle label for the rain effect of the Nightshift theme. Keep short, about 5 characters.
effects.lights: Toggle label for the glowing lights effect of the Nightshift theme. Keep short, about 7 characters.
effects.frames: Toggle label for the decorative frames effect of the Nightshift theme. Keep short, about 7 characters.
effects.clock: Toggle label for the round clock medallion art of the Nightshift theme. Keep short, about 10 characters.

deadlock_api.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Named after the Deadlock API website. Brand name, keep untranslated.
deadlock_api.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: OLED black with an electric red glow.
deadlock_api.source: Link text under the theme that points to the Deadlock API website. Brand name, keep untranslated.

statlocker.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Brand name, keep untranslated.
statlocker.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: graphite grey panels with a mint green accent.
statlocker.source: Link text under the theme that points to its website. Brand name, keep untranslated.

flint_snow.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Named after a creator persona, a fox. Name, keep untranslated.
flint_snow.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: coral fur on midnight navy with pink trim.

effects.snow: Toggle label for the falling snow effect of the Flint Snow theme. Keep short, about 4 characters.
effects.stars: Toggle label for the stars effect of the Flint Snow theme. Keep short, about 5 characters.
effects.tail: Toggle label for the fox tail art of the Flint Snow theme. Keep short, about 4 characters.
effects.tracks: Toggle label for the animal footprint art of the Flint Snow theme. Keep short, about 6 characters.

void.label: Theme name in the theme picker. An OLED black theme. Keep short, about 4 characters.
void.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: OLED black with electric violet trim.

deadchaps.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Named after the DeadChaps community. Brand name, keep untranslated.
deadchaps.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: near black panels with the purple of the DeadChaps brand. DeadChaps stays untranslated.
deadchaps.source: Link text under the theme that points to the DeadChaps website. Brand name, keep untranslated.

pretty_in_pink.label: Theme name in the theme picker. A playful pink theme. Name, may be adapted.
pretty_in_pink.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Describes its colours: candy pink and cream with pastel clouds and hearts.

effects.clouds: Toggle label for the clouds effect of the Pretty in Pink theme. Keep short, about 6 characters.
effects.hearts: Toggle label for the hearts effect of the Pretty in Pink theme. Keep short, about 6 characters.
effects.bow: Toggle label for the ribbon bow art of the Pretty in Pink theme. Keep short, about 3 characters.

catppuccin.label: Theme name in the theme picker. Brand name of a colour palette project, keep untranslated.
catppuccin.description: Theme description in the theme picker. Soft pastel colours. The palette comes in four variants (flavours) and 14 accent colours.
catppuccin.source: Link text under the theme that points to the Catppuccin palette website. Catppuccin stays untranslated.
catppuccin.variant: Label of the picker for the Catppuccin palette variant, like Latte or Mocha. Flavour here means variant. Keep short, about 7 characters.
catppuccin.accent: Label of the picker for the Catppuccin accent colour. Keep short, about 6 characters.

autostart.title_windows: Setting label on Settings, Startup. Names the switch to launch the app at Windows sign in. Windows is a product name.
autostart.title_macos: Setting label for the launch at login switch on macOS. macOS is a product name.
autostart.title_linux: Setting label for the launch at login switch on Linux desktops.
autostart.description_windows: Setting description under the autostart switch on Windows. Deadlock+ stays untranslated. Windows is a product name.
autostart.description_macos: Setting description under the autostart switch on macOS. Deadlock+ stays untranslated. macOS is a product name.
autostart.description_linux: Setting description under the autostart switch on Linux. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.
autostart.failed: Error message under the autostart switch when changing it failed. Points to the app log.
autostart.stale: Warning under the autostart switch. Launch on login points to another installed copy of the app. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.

startup.tray_description: Setting description under the tray switch. Deadlock+ stays untranslated. The tray is the system tray icon area of the taskbar.
startup.jobs_description: Setting description under Background work. Deadlock+ and Deadlock stay untranslated. Mods are game modifications. Server blocks are a Server Picker feature.
startup.all_jobs_label: Switch label in the Background work card. Master switch for all background tasks.
startup.all_jobs_description: Description under the master background tasks switch. Performance is the name of an app page. Keep it matching that page name.
startup.tasks_title: Small heading above the list of individual background tasks in Settings, Startup.
startup.tasks_description: Description under the Tasks heading. Deadlock stays untranslated. Describes the per task options: run alone, and what to do while the game is open.
startup.run_by_itself: Small switch label on each task row. Whether the task starts on its own without you asking.
startup.while_running: Small label of a dropdown on each task row. Chooses behaviour while the game runs (pause, slow down or keep running). Deadlock stays untranslated.
startup.advanced: Label of a collapsible section toggle in Settings, Startup that reveals extra options. Keep short, about 8 characters.
startup.open_on_game_start_description: Setting description under Open with Deadlock. Deadlock and Deadlock+ stay untranslated. The tray is the system tray.
startup.admin_access_ask: Option in the admin access selector. The app asks every time it needs admin rights. Keep short, about 14 characters.
startup.admin_access_description: Setting description under Admin access. Server blocks, connection monitor and frame times are feature names. Admin rights means Windows administrator.

notifications.alerts_description: Setting description under Patch and news alerts. Deadlock and Steam stay untranslated. The tray option is another setting in Startup.
notifications.maintenance_description: Setting description under Steam maintenance reminder. Mentions the usual UTC time slot and 15 to 30 minutes. Steam and Valve stay untranslated.
notifications.day: Label of the weekday dropdown for the Steam maintenance reminder. Keep short, about 4 characters.
notifications.time: Label of the time of day input for the maintenance reminder. Time is in UTC. Keep short, about 10 characters.
notifications.remind: Label of the dropdown for how long before maintenance to notify. Keep short, about 10 characters.
notifications.lead_minutes: Dropdown option for the maintenance reminder lead time. {minutes} = number of minutes, e.g. 30. Keep short, about 14 characters.
notifications.lead_hours: Dropdown option for the maintenance reminder lead time. {hours} = number of hours, e.g. 2. Keep short, about 14 characters.
notifications.overlay_description: Setting description under the Game overlay switch. Deadlock stays untranslated.
notifications.overlay_fullscreen: Warning under the overlay switch when the game runs in exclusive Full Screen. Full Screen mode and Borderless Window are Deadlock video setting names. Match the game's own translation.
notifications.overlay_test_description: Setting description under Test the overlay.
notifications.overlay_notifications_description: Setting description under Overlay notifications. 'Match found' and 'Notifications' are names of other settings, keep them consistent.
notifications.overlay_notifications_button: Button on Settings, Game overlay that jumps to the Notifications settings. Keep short, about 18 characters.
notifications.overlay_test_button: Button that shows a sample overlay notification. Keep short, about 9 characters.
notifications.overlay_test_countdown: Button text while the test notification counts down. {seconds} = seconds left, e.g. 3. Keep short, about 14 characters.
notifications.overlay_test_failed: Toast shown on Settings, Notifications when the test notification in the game overlay could not be shown.
notifications.overlay_seconds: Slider value for overlay duration. {seconds} = number of seconds, e.g. 5. 's' is the unit for seconds. Keep short, about 5 characters.

position.top_left: Option in the overlay position picker. Screen corner. Keep short, about 8 characters.
position.top_center: Option in the overlay position picker. Top middle of the screen. Keep short, about 10 characters.
position.top_right: Option in the overlay position picker. Screen corner. Keep short, about 9 characters.
position.left: Option in the overlay position picker. Middle of the left screen edge. Keep short, about 4 characters.
position.right: Option in the overlay position picker. Middle of the right screen edge. Keep short, about 5 characters.
position.bottom_left: Option in the overlay position picker. Screen corner. Keep short, about 11 characters.
position.bottom_center: Option in the overlay position picker. Bottom middle of the screen. Keep short, about 13 characters.
position.bottom_right: Option in the overlay position picker. Screen corner. Keep short, about 12 characters.
position.center: Label in the middle of the overlay position picker. It marks where the Match found notification shows, in the screen center. Keep short, about 12 characters.

notifications.overlay_match_found_description: Setting description under the Match found notification setting. Queue is the matchmaking queue.
notifications.overlay_queue_stopped_description: Setting description under the Queue stopped notification setting. Queue is the matchmaking queue.
notifications.server_blocks_updated_description: Setting description under Server blocks updated. Valve stays untranslated. Server Picker is a feature name, keep consistent.
notifications.server_blocks_stale_description: Setting description under Server blocks out of date. Server Picker is a feature name, keep consistent.
notifications.break_reminder_description: Setting description under Break reminder. Sessions is an app page name, keep consistent with it.
notifications.front_page_after_match_description: Setting description under Front page after each match. Front page is a newspaper style recap. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.
notifications.front_page_modes: Small label above a row of game mode toggle buttons, also read by screen readers before each mode name. Selects which match modes get a front page.
notifications.front_page_mode_aria: Screen reader label for a toggle on Settings, Notifications. {mode} = game mode name, e.g. Ranked. Game mode names are Deadlock game terms.
notifications.front_page_overlay_alert_description: Setting description under Front page waiting. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.
notifications.delivery_label: Label of a dropdown on each notification row. Chooses how the notification is delivered. Keep short, about 9 characters.

delivery.both: Option in the delivery dropdown. Shows in the game overlay while playing, otherwise as a desktop notification. Keep short, about 30 characters.
delivery.overlay: Option in the delivery dropdown. Only the in game overlay. Keep short, about 14 characters.
delivery.os: Option in the delivery dropdown. A normal operating system desktop notification. Keep short, about 20 characters.
delivery.quiet: Option in the delivery dropdown. Desktop notification, but suppressed while the game is running. Keep short, about 26 characters.
delivery.center: Option in the delivery dropdown. Only kept in the app's notification center, no popup. Keep short, about 25 characters.

notifications.overlay_off_fallback: Hint under a notification row when the game overlay is off. The notification goes to the desktop instead.
notifications.overlay_off_hidden: Hint under a notification row when the game overlay is off. The notification is not shown at all.
notifications.dispatch_alerts_description: Setting description under New Dispatch edition. Dispatch is a newspaper style recap. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.

weekdays.monday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.
weekdays.tuesday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.
weekdays.wednesday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.
weekdays.thursday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.
weekdays.friday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.
weekdays.saturday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.
weekdays.sunday: Day name in the maintenance reminder weekday dropdown.

countdown.days: Short countdown text for time until maintenance. {days} = whole days, e.g. 2. {hours} = hours, e.g. 5. 'd' and 'h' are unit abbreviations. Keep short, about 10 characters.
countdown.hours: Short countdown text for time until maintenance. {hours} = hours, e.g. 3. {minutes} = minutes, e.g. 20. Keep short, about 14 characters.
countdown.minutes: Short countdown text for time until maintenance. {minutes} = minutes, e.g. 45. Keep short, about 8 characters.
countdown.soon: Countdown text used when under one minute is left until maintenance. Fits into a sentence.

discord.presence_description: Page subtitle on the Discord presence page. Discord is a product name.
discord.level_off: Option title in the presence level picker. Presence is hidden. Keep short, about 3 characters.
discord.level_basic: Option title in the presence level picker. Minimal info shown. Keep short, about 5 characters.
discord.level_detailed: Option title in the presence level picker. Full info shown. Keep short, about 8 characters.
discord.level_off_description: Option description under the Off level in the presence picker.
discord.level_basic_description: Option description under the Basic level in the presence picker. Deadlock stays untranslated.
discord.level_detailed_description: Option description under the Detailed level in the presence picker. Hero, mode and rank are Deadlock game terms, match the game's own translation.
discord.support_label: Setting label on the Discord presence page. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.
discord.support_description: Setting description. Download Deadlock+ is the text on a button added to your Discord activity. Deadlock+ and Discord stay untranslated.
discord.logo_label: Setting label on the Discord presence page. Deadlock+ stays untranslated.
discord.logo_description: Setting description. Deadlock stays untranslated. The large image is the big picture on a Discord activity card.
discord.delay_label: Setting label on the Discord presence page. Names the slider for how long Discord status waits before updating.
discord.delay_description: Setting description under Delay. Friends see your Discord status late by the chosen time.
discord.delay_off: Value shown on the delay slider when there is no delay. Keep short, about 3 characters.
discord.delay_seconds: Value shown on the delay slider. {seconds} = number of seconds, e.g. 30. 's' is the unit for seconds. Keep short, about 5 characters.
discord.client_running: Status text under a Discord app in the list. The app is open now. Keep short, about 7 characters.
discord.client_not_running: Status text under a Discord app in the list. The app is not open. Keep short, about 11 characters.
discord.client_other_hint: Subtitle under the Other entry in the Discord apps list. Vesktop is a third party Discord app name, keep untranslated.
discord.clients_description: Description under the Discord apps heading. Discord is a product name. Lists which installed Discord apps show your presence.
discord.client_stable: Name of the standard Discord app in the apps list. Product name, keep untranslated.
discord.client_ptb: Name of Discord's Public Test Build app in the apps list. Product name, keep untranslated.
discord.client_canary: Name of Discord's Canary app in the apps list. Product name, keep untranslated.
discord.client_other_label: Name of the entry for any other Discord compatible app in the Discord apps list. Keep short, about 5 characters.
discord.client_stable_name: Name of the standard Discord app used in the status line. Product name, keep untranslated.
discord.client_ptb_name: Name of Discord's Public Test Build app used in the status line. Product name, keep untranslated.
discord.client_canary_name: Name of Discord's Canary app used in the status line. Product name, keep untranslated.
discord.client_other_name: Name of an unknown Discord compatible app in the status line. {pipe} = connection slot number, e.g. 1. Discord stays untranslated.
discord.status_off: Status line on the Discord presence page when presence is turned off. Keep short, about 3 characters.
discord.status_none: Status line on the Discord presence page when no Discord app is open. Discord is a product name.
discord.status_waiting: Status line on Settings, Discord. Discord is running and the app is waiting for the game Deadlock to start.
discord.status_connecting: Status line on Settings, Discord. The app is connecting to Discord.
discord.status_showing: Status line on the Discord presence page. {clients} = comma separated Discord app names, e.g. "Discord, Discord PTB".

discord_editor.description: Description under the Presence editor heading. Activity means the Discord status card. States, lines, images and timer are parts of that card.
discord_editor.loading: Loading text shown in place of the Discord activity editor on Settings > Discord until it is ready.
discord_editor.states: Screen reader label for the list of activity states (Main menu, In a match, etc.) in the Discord activity editor.
discord_editor.customised: Small status text next to a field in the Discord activity editor. Means you changed this field. Keep short, about 10 characters.
discord_editor.inherited: Small status text next to a field in the Discord activity editor. Means the field still uses the default value. Keep short, about 7 characters.
discord_editor.field_details: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the first text line of the Discord card.
discord_editor.field_state: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the second text line of the Discord card.
discord_editor.field_large_image: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the big picture on the Discord card.
discord_editor.field_large_text: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the text shown when hovering the large image on Discord.
discord_editor.field_small_image: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the small round picture on the Discord card.
discord_editor.field_small_text: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the text shown when hovering the small image on Discord.
discord_editor.field_timer: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the timer shown on the Discord card.
discord_editor.timer_aria: Screen reader label for the dropdown that picks which timer Discord shows.
discord_editor.reset_field: Screen reader label and tooltip on a reset icon button in the Discord activity editor. {field} = field name, e.g. "Top line".
discord_editor.reset_scope: Button in the Discord activity editor that resets the currently selected state to its defaults.
discord_editor.reset_all: Button in the Discord activity editor that resets all presence settings. Opens a confirmation dialog.
discord_editor.reset_all_title: Title of the confirmation dialog opened by the Reset everything button in the Discord activity editor.
discord_editor.reset_all_description: Body text of the reset confirmation dialog in the Discord activity editor. Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated.
discord_editor.all_heroes: Option in the hero dropdown of the Discord activity editor. Means the default that applies to every hero. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.sample_hero: Sample hero name used only in the Discord card preview. Use the game's own translation of the hero Haze. Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.image_enabled: Screen reader label for a switch that shows or hides an image on the Discord card. {image} = image field name, e.g. "Large image".
discord_editor.image_source: Screen reader label for the dropdown that picks where an image comes from. {image} = image field name, e.g. "Small image".
discord_editor.image_url: Screen reader label for the text input holding an image web address. {image} = image field name, e.g. "Large image".
discord_editor.source_heroPortrait: Dropdown option for an image source on the Discord activity editor. Picture of the hero you play. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.source_heroIcon: Dropdown option for an image source on the Discord activity editor. Small icon of the hero you play. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.source_rankBadge: Dropdown option for an image source on the Discord activity editor. Badge image of your rank. Rank is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.source_modeIcon: Dropdown option for an image source on the Discord activity editor. Icon of the current game mode.
discord_editor.source_customUrl: Dropdown option for an image source on the Discord activity editor. You type your own image web address.
discord_editor.timer_none: Dropdown option for the Discord timer. Means no timer is shown.
discord_editor.timer_elapsedInState: Dropdown option for the Discord timer. Counts time since the current activity state began. Contains "Deadlock", which stays untranslated.
discord_editor.timer_matchTime: Dropdown option for the Discord timer. Shows the running match time.
discord_editor.preview: Screen reader label for the Discord card preview group in the Discord activity editor.
discord_editor.preview_header: Small uppercase header on the Discord card preview. Copies Discord's own "Playing" header. Keep short, about 7 characters.
discord_editor.preview_disabled: Message in the Discord card preview when the selected state sends no activity to Discord.
discord_editor.preview_failed: Error message in the Discord card preview when it can't be drawn. Tells the user to check the lines for a typo.
discord_editor.preview_large_text: Line in the Discord card preview showing the large image hover text. {text} = the hover text, e.g. "Haze".
discord_editor.preview_small_text: Line in the Discord card preview showing the small image hover text. {text} = the hover text, e.g. "Ranked".
discord_editor.share: Section heading in the Discord activity editor for sharing presets (export and import of settings).
discord_editor.share_description: Description under the Share a preset heading in the Discord activity editor. Names the Copy preset button and the Import button; match their labels.
discord_editor.import_label: Label of the text box where the user pastes preset text in the Discord activity editor.
discord_editor.import: Button in the Discord activity editor. Imports pasted preset text. Keep short, about 6 characters.
discord_editor.import_file: Button in the Discord activity editor. Opens a file picker to import a preset from a file. Keep short, about 16 characters.
discord_editor.export: Button in the Discord activity editor. Copies your preset to the clipboard as text. Keep short, about 11 characters.
discord_editor.exported: Toast shown after the preset is copied to the clipboard in the Discord activity editor.
discord_editor.export_failed: Error toast shown when the preset could not be copied to the clipboard.
discord_editor.imported: Toast shown after a preset is imported in the Discord activity editor.
discord_editor.import_failed: Error message. Shown in the Discord activity editor when an imported preset file could not be read.
discord_editor.save_failed: Error message. Shown in the Discord activity editor when the changes could not be saved.

state.playing: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown while in a game. Keep short, about 10 characters.
state.mainMenu: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. The game's main menu screen. Keep short, about 10 characters.
state.hideout: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Hideout is a Deadlock game term, match the game's own translation.
state.findingMatch: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown while searching for a match. Keep short, about 16 characters.
state.matchFound: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown when a match was found. Keep short, about 11 characters.
state.preGame: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. The phase before a match starts, like hero pick. Keep short, about 8 characters.
state.inMatch: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown during a match. Keep short, about 10 characters.
state.streetBrawlRound: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Street Brawl is a Deadlock game mode, match the game's own translation.
state.paused: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown while the match is paused. Keep short, about 6 characters.
state.spectating: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown while watching someone else's match. Keep short, about 10 characters.
state.postGame: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. The phase after a match ends. Keep short, about 9 characters.
state.privateLobby: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. A private lobby with friends. Keep short, about 13 characters.
state.practice: Name of an activity state in the Discord activity editor list. Shown in practice mode. Keep short, about 8 characters.

variant.solo: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. You queue alone. Keep short, about 4 characters.
variant.party: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. You queue in a group. Keep short, about 5 characters.
variant.unranked: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A non ranked match. Ranked is a Deadlock game term. Keep short, about 8 characters.
variant.ranked: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A ranked match. Deadlock game term, match the game's translation. Keep short, about 6 characters.
variant.bots: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A match against bots. Keep short, about 4 characters.
variant.tutorial: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. The tutorial. Keep short, about 8 characters.
variant.normal: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A standard match. Keep short, about 6 characters.
variant.streetBrawl: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. Street Brawl is a Deadlock game mode, match the game's own translation.
variant.sandbox: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. Sandbox is a Deadlock game mode, match the game's own translation.
variant.exploreNyc: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. Explore NYC is a Deadlock game mode, match the game's own translation.
variant.won: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A match you won. Keep short, about 3 characters.
variant.lost: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A match you lost. Keep short, about 4 characters.
variant.unscored: Name of a variant of an activity state in the Discord activity editor. A match without a win or loss result. Keep short, about 8 characters.

discord_editor.editing: Label of the hero dropdown in the Discord activity editor. Picks which hero's lines you edit. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.editing_default_hint: Hint text under the hero dropdown in the Discord activity editor when the default is selected. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.editing_hero_hint: Hint text under the hero dropdown in the Discord activity editor. {hero} = hero name, e.g. "Haze". "Default" names the Default option, match it.
discord_editor.no_hero_layer: Hint text in the Discord activity editor for states that can't differ per hero. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
discord_editor.row_enabled: Screen reader label for the switch on an activity state row. {name} = state name, e.g. "Main menu". Discord stays untranslated.
discord_editor.no_top_line: Secondary text on an activity state row when its top line is empty. Top line names the first text line field, match it.
discord_editor.insert_variable: Button in the Discord activity editor that opens a menu of values to add into a line. Keep short, about 12 characters.
discord_editor.insert_into: Small heading in the insert value menu. {field} = name of the text field that gets the value, e.g. "Top line".
discord_editor.sensitive: Warning badge on a value in the syntax help, meaning it reveals the match ID to others. Keep short, about 20 characters.
discord_editor.syntax_help: Menu item in the insert value menu that opens the syntax help card.
discord_editor.variables_hint: Hint text next to the Insert value button in the Discord activity editor.

placeholder.hero: Short description of a value you can insert, shown in lists. The hero you play. Hero is a Deadlock game term.
placeholder.mode: Short description of a value you can insert. The match mode, e.g. "Ranked". Ranked is a Deadlock game term.
placeholder.gameMode: Short description of a value you can insert. The game mode, e.g. "Street Brawl". Deadlock game term, match the game's translation.
placeholder.rank: Short description of a value you can insert. Your rank in ranked matches. Ranks are Deadlock game terms.
placeholder.kills: Short description of a value you can insert. The number of kills you have in the match.
placeholder.deaths: Short description of a value you can insert. The number of deaths you have in the match.
placeholder.assists: Short description of a value you can insert. The number of assists you have in the match.
placeholder.souls: Short description of a value you can insert. Your souls, e.g. "24.1k". Souls is a Deadlock game term, match the game's translation.
placeholder.partySize: Short description of a value you can insert. How many players are in your party.
placeholder.partyMax: Short description of a value you can insert. The largest size the party can be.
placeholder.round: Short description of a value you can insert. The Street Brawl round number. Street Brawl is a Deadlock game term.
placeholder.scoreAmber: Short description of a value you can insert. The Amber team score in Street Brawl. Amber and Street Brawl are Deadlock game terms.
placeholder.scoreSapphire: Short description of a value you can insert. The Sapphire team score in Street Brawl. Sapphire and Street Brawl are Deadlock game terms.
placeholder.elapsed: Short description of a value you can insert. Time spent in the current activity state.
placeholder.queueTime: Short description of a value you can insert. How long you have been in the matchmaking queue.
placeholder.result: Short description of a value you can insert. Whether you won or lost the match.
placeholder.matchId: Short description of a value you can insert. The number that identifies the match.
placeholder.heroPresence: Short description of a value you can insert. A line of text belonging to your hero, used in the Hideout. Hero and Hideout are Deadlock game terms.

discord_editor.preview_game: Game name shown on the Discord card preview. "Deadlock" stays untranslated.
discord_editor.preview_logo: Tooltip on the logo in the Discord card preview. Explains Discord shows the Deadlock logo when no large image is sent. "Deadlock" stays untranslated.
discord_editor.preview_large_image: Screen reader text for the large image in the Discord card preview.
discord_editor.preview_small_image: Screen reader text for the small image in the Discord card preview.
discord_editor.preview_elapsed: Timer line on the Discord card preview. {time} = elapsed clock time, e.g. "12:34".
discord_editor.preview_discord_row: Small badge in the Discord card preview for extras Discord adds itself. Keep short, about 18 characters.
discord_editor.preview_discord_sample: Note in the Discord card preview about extras Discord adds on its own, like Streak and Trending. These are Discord's own terms, match Discord's translation.
discord_editor.preview_support_button: Fake button in the Discord card preview. Imitates the button on the Discord card. Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated.

syntax.title: Heading of the syntax help card in the Discord activity editor.
syntax.copied: Toast shown after a syntax example is copied to the clipboard.
syntax.copy_example: Screen reader label for a clickable example that copies it to the clipboard. {text} = the example text, e.g. "{kills}".
syntax.nothing: Shown in the syntax help when an example result is an empty line.
syntax.no_sample: Shown in the values table of the syntax help when the preview has no sample for that value.
syntax.rules_title: Section heading in the syntax help card above a short list of rules.
syntax.rule_length: Bullet point in the syntax help rules list. Discord limits each line to 2 to 128 characters.
syntax.rule_empty: Bullet point in the syntax help rules list about an empty line.
syntax.rule_unclosed: Bullet point in the syntax help rules list. Keep the "[[" characters as written.
syntax.rule_unknown: Bullet point in the syntax help rules list about a mistyped value name.
syntax.privacy: Paragraph at the end of the syntax help card about which values are available and when the match ID is hidden. Basic and Detailed are presence levels, match those labels.
syntax.intro: Intro paragraph under the heading of the syntax help card. Contains "Discord", which stays untranslated.
syntax.you_see: Label before the result of an example in the syntax help, shown only on narrow windows. Keep short, about 8 characters.
syntax.step1_title: Heading of step 1 in the syntax help. Explains writing a value name in curly brackets.
syntax.step1_body: Body of step 1 in the syntax help. Curly brackets are literal characters. Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated.
syntax.step2_title: Heading of step 2 in the syntax help. Explains what happens when a value is unknown.
syntax.step2_body: Body of step 2 in the syntax help. Explains a missing value is left out.
syntax.step3_title: Heading of step 3 in the syntax help. Explains optional parts in double square brackets.
syntax.step3_body: Body of step 3 in the syntax help. Double square brackets are literal characters.
syntax.step4_title: Heading of step 4 in the syntax help. Explains fallback choices.
syntax.step4_body: Body of step 4 in the syntax help. Two bars are the literal characters "||". Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated.
syntax.list_title: Section heading in the syntax help above the table of all insertable values.
syntax.list_body: Intro text above the values table in the syntax help. "Insert value" names a button, match its label.
syntax.col_variable: Table column header in the syntax help values table. Names the value you insert. Keep short, about 5 characters.
syntax.col_shows: Table column header in the syntax help values table. Describes what the value displays. Keep short, about 13 characters.
syntax.col_example: Table column header in the syntax help values table. Shows a sample result. Keep short, about 7 characters.
syntax.group_you: Group heading in the syntax help values table for values about you. Keep short, about 3 characters.
syntax.group_match: Group heading in the syntax help values table for values about the match. Keep short, about 5 characters.
syntax.group_party: Group heading in the syntax help values table for party and queue values. Keep short, about 15 characters.
syntax.group_streetBrawl: Group heading in the syntax help values table. Street Brawl is a Deadlock game mode, match the game's own translation.
syntax.group_misc: Group heading in the syntax help values table for all other values. Keep short, about 5 characters.

discord_editor.timer_queueTime: Dropdown option for the Discord timer. Counts time spent in the matchmaking queue.
discord_editor.field_party_size: Field label in the Discord activity editor for the switch that shows the party size.
discord_editor.party_size_aria: Screen reader label for the switch that shows party size on the Discord card.
discord_editor.party_size_hint: Hint text next to the party size switch. The brackets show the format of the party count, e.g. "(2 of 6)".
discord_editor.preview_party: Party count in the Discord card preview. {size} = players in party, e.g. 2. {max} = largest party size, e.g. 6.
discord_editor.detailed_only: Notice in the Discord activity editor when presence level is not Detailed. Basic and Detailed are presence levels, match their labels. "Playing" matches Discord's header.
discord_editor.load_error: Error message. Shown in place of the Discord activity (presence) editor when it fails to load.

privacy.telemetry_description: Setting description on Settings > Privacy for the usage data toggle. Lists what is sent and what never is.
privacy.telemetry_reset: Button on Settings > Privacy. Replaces the random usage data ID with a new one.
privacy.telemetry_reset_done: Toast shown after the usage data ID was reset.
privacy.telemetry_reset_failed: Toast shown on Settings, Privacy when resetting the anonymous usage data ID failed.
privacy.ingest_waiting: Status line on Settings > Privacy. Match sharing is waiting for the user to answer a prompt.
privacy.ingest_off: Status line on Settings > Privacy. Match sharing is turned off. Keep short, about 3 characters.
privacy.ingest_no_cache: Error status on Settings > Privacy. Steam's saved web data was not found on this PC. Steam is a product name and stays untranslated.
privacy.ingest_failed: Error status on Settings > Privacy. The last match upload failed and the user can check the log.
privacy.ingest_watching: Status line on Settings > Privacy. {count} = number of matches shared in this app session, e.g. 3.
privacy.ingest_description: Setting description on Settings > Privacy for the toggle that shares matches with the Deadlock API. Detail means full match data.
privacy.gc_description: Setting description on Settings > Privacy for the toggle that fills in matches the Deadlock API is missing. Contains "Deadlock", which stays untranslated.
privacy.how_it_works: Expandable summary label on Settings > Privacy. Opens a short list explaining how a sharing option works.
privacy.ingest_how_find: Bullet in the How it works list for match sharing. Explains where Deadlock+ finds match data. Contains "Deadlock+" and "Deadlock", which stay untranslated.
privacy.ingest_how_send: Bullet in the How it works list for match sharing. Says what is sent. Contains "Deadlock API", a service name, which stays untranslated.
privacy.gc_how_login: Bullet in the How it works list for the Steam login option. Steam stays untranslated.
privacy.gc_how_limit: Bullet in the How it works list for the Steam login option. States a daily limit per account.
privacy.gc_how_game: Bullet in the How it works list for the Steam login option. Contains "Deadlock", which stays untranslated.
privacy.gc_how_send: Bullet in the How it works list for the Steam login option. Says what is sent. Steam stays untranslated.
privacy.gc_own_label: Setting label on Settings > Privacy for a sub setting that recovers the user's own match history.
privacy.gc_own_description: Setting description under Recover my match history. Contains "Deadlock API", a service name, which stays untranslated.
privacy.advanced: Expandable section heading on Settings > Privacy that holds advanced options. Keep short, about 8 characters.
privacy.gc_own_open: Link button on Settings > Privacy that goes to the Match History page. Match the Match History page name.

shared.title: Expandable section heading on Settings > Privacy listing matches the user has shared.
shared.source_steam: Table cell on the shared matches list showing the source of the data. Steam is a product name and stays untranslated.
shared.source_deadlock: Table cell on the shared matches list showing the source of the data was the game. "Deadlock" stays untranslated.
shared.source_login: Table cell on the shared matches list showing the source of the data was a Steam login. Steam stays untranslated.
shared.with_replay: Badge in the shared matches heading. {count} = number of shared matches with a replay, e.g. 12. Keep short, about 15 characters.
shared.when: Table column header in the shared matches list for the time of the match. Keep short, about 4 characters.
shared.match: Table column header in the shared matches list for the match ID. Keep short, about 5 characters.
shared.from: Table column header in the shared matches list for where the data came from. Keep short, about 4 characters.
shared.details: Table column header in the shared matches list. Shows whether match details were sent. Keep short, about 7 characters.
shared.replay: Table column header in the shared matches list. Shows whether the replay was sent. Keep short, about 6 characters.
shared.sent: Screen reader label for a check mark icon in the shared matches table. The data was sent.
shared.not_sent: Screen reader label for a dash icon in the shared matches table. The data was not sent.
shared.empty: Empty state text in the shared matches list on Settings > Privacy.
shared.load_error: Error message. Shown on Settings, Privacy when the list of shared matches could not be read.

about_page.copy: Button on Settings > About. Copies version details to the clipboard. Keep short, about 4 characters.
about_page.copied: Toast shown after version details were copied on Settings > About.
about_page.copy_failed: Error toast shown when version details could not be copied to the clipboard.
about_page.install: Button on Settings > About that installs an available update. {version} = version number, e.g. "0.15.0".
about_page.auto_check_label: Setting label on Settings > About for the switch that checks for updates on its own.
about_page.auto_check_description: Setting description on Settings > About for automatic update checks. GitHub is a product name and stays untranslated.
about_page.whats_new_in: Expandable heading on Settings > About for the release notes. {version} = version number, e.g. "0.15.0".
about_page.version_error: Error message. Shown on Settings, About in the version card when the app version could not be read.

diagnostics.description: Setting description on Settings > Diagnostics for the session log viewer.
diagnostics.collapse: Button on the log viewer that makes it smaller. Keep short, about 8 characters.
diagnostics.expand: Button on the log viewer that makes it bigger. Keep short, about 6 characters.

licenses.read_full: Link button on Settings > Licenses that opens the full licence of the app on the web. Licence here is the legal document.
licenses.terms_link: Small link on a font or artwork entry in Settings > Licenses. Opens the licence terms on the web.
licenses.copyright: Expandable summary label on a licence entry. Opens the copyright notice text.
licenses.fonts_heading: Section heading on Settings > Licenses above the list of fonts and artwork used in the app.
licenses.app_summary: Short licence summary on Settings > Licenses. Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated. Use the official name of the GNU General Public License in your language.
licenses.app_warranty: Short sentence under the licence summary on Settings > Licenses. Means no warranty is given.
licenses.disclaimer: Legal disclaimer on Settings > Licenses. "Deadlock+", "Deadlock", "Steam" and "Valve Corporation" stay untranslated.
licenses.kind_font: Small tag on a Settings > Licenses entry saying it is a font. Keep short, about 4 characters.
licenses.kind_artwork: Small tag on a Settings > Licenses entry saying it is artwork. Keep short, about 7 characters.
licenses.terms_not_open_source: Short licence note on a font entry in Settings > Licenses. The font license is not open source.
licenses.terms_valve_oracle: Short licence note on the VALVE Oracle font entry in Settings > Licenses.
licenses.terms_valve_pulp: Short licence note on the Valve Pulp font entry in Settings > Licenses. "Steam Subscriber Agreement" is a legal document name, use Valve's official translation if one exists.
licenses.terms_twemoji: Short licence note on the Twemoji flag artwork entry in Settings > Licenses. MIT is a licence name and stays untranslated.
licenses.dependencies_title: Expandable heading on Settings > Licenses for the list of open source packages used.
licenses.dependencies_description: Description under the dependencies heading on Settings > Licenses.
licenses.dependencies_failed: Error message on Settings > Licenses when the dependency licences could not be loaded.
licenses.dependencies_loading: Loading text in the dependencies list on Settings > Licenses.
licenses.dependencies_packages: Label under a number in a three column summary on Settings > Licenses. Total of all packages. Keep short, about 8 characters.
licenses.dependencies_rust: Label under a number in a three column summary on Settings > Licenses. Rust is a programming language name. Keep short, about 11 characters.
licenses.dependencies_npm: Label under a number in a three column summary on Settings > Licenses. npm is a package manager name. Keep short, about 12 characters.
licenses.dependencies_no_file: Note under a group of packages on Settings > Licenses. {title} = licence name, e.g. "MIT".

thanks.intro: Intro text on the Thanks card in Settings. Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated.
thanks.contributors: Section heading on the Thanks card in Settings. People who contributed code or docs.
thanks.contributors_description: Short description under the Contributors heading on the Thanks card.
thanks.translators: Section heading on the Thanks card in Settings. People who translated the app.
thanks.translators_description: Short description under the Translators heading on the Thanks card. Contains "Deadlock+", which stays untranslated.
thanks.donators: Section heading on the Thanks card in Settings. People who donated money.
thanks.donators_description: Short description under the Donators heading on the Thanks card.
thanks.others: Plural text at the end of the donators list on the Thanks card. {count} = number of further named donators, e.g. 4.
thanks.anonymous: Plural text on the Thanks card when all donators are anonymous. {count} = number of anonymous donators, e.g. 3.
thanks.nobody_yet: Empty state text on the Thanks card when no names are listed.

storage.subtitle: Description under the Storage page heading. Deadlock and Deadlock+ stay untranslated.
storage.show_paths: Button on the Storage page that reveals file paths under each entry. Keep short, about 12 characters.
storage.hide_paths: Button on the Storage page that hides the file paths again. Keep short, about 12 characters.
storage.refresh: Button on the Storage page that measures file sizes again. Keep short, about 10 characters.
storage.looking: Loading text shown on the Storage page while it scans folders. Casual tone.
storage.footnote: Footnote at the bottom of the Storage page about what can be cleared. Deadlock and Deadlock+ stay untranslated.

summary.total: Label above the total size of all files found, in the Storage summary. Keep short, about 12 characters.
summary.can_clear: Label above the size that can be cleared, in the Storage summary. Keep short, about 20 characters.
summary.clear_regenerable: Button in the Storage summary that clears every file the game rebuilds itself. Keep short, about 25 characters.
summary.total_at_least: Total size shown on the Storage page when some folders could not be measured, so the real total is larger. {size} = size, e.g. 1.2 GB.

entry.path_missing: Text in a Storage entry row, shown in place of the file path when the folder does not exist on this PC.
entry.not_found: Short status in a Storage entry row, shown on the right when the folder does not exist. Keep short, about 10 characters.
entry.retry_aria: Screen reader label for the Retry button in a Storage entry row. {label} = entry name, e.g. "Replays".
entry.retry: Small link button in a Storage entry row, shown when measuring its size failed. Keep short, about 6 characters.
entry.measuring: Screen reader label for the spinner in a Storage entry row while its size is measured.
entry.open_aria: Screen reader label for the icon button that opens the page for an entry. {label} = entry name, e.g. "Replays".
entry.open_title: Tooltip on the icon button that opens the page for an entry. {label} = entry name, e.g. "Replays".
entry.reveal_aria: Screen reader label for the icon button that shows an entry in its folder. {label} = entry name, e.g. "Shader cache".
entry.reveal_title: Tooltip on the icon button in a Storage entry row that opens the folder in File Explorer.
entry.clear_aria: Screen reader label for the icon button that clears an entry. {label} = entry name, e.g. "Shader cache".
entry.clear_title: Tooltip on the icon button in a Storage entry row that deletes its files. Keep short, about 6 characters.
entry.unmeasured: Size label on a Storage page row whose size could not be measured. Keep short, about 16 characters.

dialog.cancel: Cancel button in the Storage clear confirmation dialog. Keep short, about 8 characters.
dialog.clear: Red confirm button in the Storage clear confirmation dialog that deletes the files. Keep short, about 6 characters.

clear.title: Title of the confirmation dialog for clearing one Storage entry. {name} = lowercase entry name, e.g. "replays" or "the shader cache".
clear.body: Body of the clear confirmation dialog. {size} = size freed, e.g. "1.2 GB". {consequence} = a sentence on what happens after clearing, shown as is.
clear.all_title: Title of the confirmation dialog for clearing all rebuildable Storage entries at once.
clear.all_body: Body of the clear all dialog. {size} = size freed, e.g. "1.2 GB". {names} = comma separated entry names, e.g. "Shader cache, Console log".

toast.freed: Toast shown after clearing files. {size} = space freed, e.g. "1.2 GB".
toast.nothing: Toast shown when clearing found no files to remove.
toast.clear_failed: Toast shown on the Storage page when clearing items failed. {count} = number of items that failed, e.g. 2.
toast.reveal_failed: Toast shown when a folder could not be opened in the file manager from the Storage page or the crash dialog.

age.today: Age text in a Storage entry row, used inside the oldest item note. Means the oldest file is from today. Lowercase.
age.days: Age text in a Storage entry row for the oldest file, plural forms. {count} = days, e.g. 5. Lowercase.
age.months: Age text in a Storage entry row for the oldest file, plural forms. {count} = months, e.g. 3. Lowercase.
age.years: Age text in a Storage entry row for the oldest file, plural forms. {count} = years, e.g. 2. Lowercase.

storage.units_oldest: Detail line in a Storage entry row. {units} = item count text, e.g. "12 replays". {age} = age of the oldest item, e.g. "3 months".

deadlock.label: Group heading on the Storage page for files kept by the game. Deadlock is the game name and stays untranslated.
deadlock.blurb: Description under the Deadlock group heading on the Storage page. Deadlock is the game name and stays untranslated.

deadlock_plus.label: Group heading on the Storage page for files kept by this app. Deadlock+ is the app name and stays untranslated.
deadlock_plus.blurb: Description under the Deadlock+ group heading on the Storage page. It means files this app keeps.

mods.label: Group heading on the Storage page for mod files and their backups.
mods.blurb: Description under the mods group heading on the Storage page. Says Deadlock+ does not clear these files.

regenerates.label: Badge on a Storage entry for files that are rebuilt automatically. Keep short, about 16 characters.
regenerates.hint: Tooltip for the Rebuilds itself badge on a Storage entry.

history.label: Badge on a Storage entry for records of past activity. Keep short, about 8 characters.
history.hint: Tooltip for the History badge on a Storage entry. Warns the data cannot be rebuilt once deleted.

backup.label: Badge on a Storage entry for safety copies. Keep short, about 8 characters.
backup.hint: Tooltip for the Backup badge on a Storage entry.

yours.label: Badge on a Storage entry for the user's own data. Keep short, about 6 characters.
yours.hint: Tooltip for the Yours badge on a Storage entry.

managed.label: Badge on a Storage entry for files owned by mods or a mod manager. Keep short, about 16 characters.
managed.hint: Tooltip for the Managed by mods badge on a Storage entry.

replays.label: Storage entry name for saved match replays. Row heading on the Storage page.
replays.clear_name: Lowercase name of the replays entry, inserted into the clear dialog title as {name}, e.g. "Clear replays?".
replays.description: Description line of the replays entry on the Storage page. Deadlock stays untranslated.
replays.consequence: Sentence shown in the clear dialog for replays. Replays is a page name in this app.
replays.units: Count shown in the replays Storage row, plural forms. {count} = number of replays, e.g. 14.

hero_presence_cache.label: Storage entry name for a small cache file about heroes. Row heading on the Storage page.
hero_presence_cache.clear_name: Lowercase name of this entry, inserted into the clear dialog title as {name}, e.g. "Clear hero presence cache?".
hero_presence_cache.description: Description line of the hero presence cache entry on the Storage page.
hero_presence_cache.consequence: Sentence shown in the clear dialog for the hero presence cache.

shader_cache.label: Storage entry name for the game's compiled shader cache. Row heading on the Storage page.
shader_cache.clear_name: Name of the shader cache, inserted into the clear dialog title as {name}, e.g. "Clear the shader cache?". Keep the article.
shader_cache.description: Description line of the shader cache entry on the Storage page. Shaders are GPU programs.
shader_cache.consequence: Sentence shown in the clear dialog for the shader cache. Stutter means brief frame rate drops.

console_log.label: Storage entry name for the game's console log file. Row heading on the Storage page.
console_log.clear_name: Name of the console log, inserted into the clear dialog title as {name}, e.g. "Clear the console log?". Keep the article.
console_log.description: Description line of the console log entry. Keep the condebug launch option, with its leading dash, exactly as written in English.
console_log.consequence: Sentence shown in the clear dialog for the console log.

voice_ban_backups.consequence: Sentence shown in the clear dialog for mute list backups.
voice_ban_backups.units: Count shown in the mute list backups row, plural forms. {count} = number of backups, e.g. 6.
